sec-head.p: Expert guidance on choosing and building the right search approach for your data and use case.

card.p: An independent assessment of your data, user queries, and performance requirements, resulting in a recommendation: semantic, keyword, or hybrid, with benchmarks.
Vector search implementation using embeddings, ANN indexes, and reranking for understanding user intent and handling synonyms.
Full-text search with BM25, inverted indexes, and advanced query parsing for exact matches and structured queries.
Combining semantic and keyword search with fusion algorithms (RRF, weighted scoring) to maximize recall and precision.
Audit of existing search systems to identify failure points, measure latency, recall, and precision, and recommend improvements.

card cta-card.h3: Not sure which search approach you need?
card cta-card.p: Try the comparison above, or get a personalized recommendation.

ul: User queries are natural language, conversational, or contain synonyms: semantic search captures meaning, not just words.
Keyword search fails on ambiguous or long-tail queries: semantic search bridges vocabulary gaps and returns relevant results even with no exact match.
But semantic search fails on precise numeric filters, product codes, or proper names: vector similarity can miss exact matches.
Hybrid search solves this by combining semantic recall with keyword precision, using reciprocal rank fusion (RRF) to blend scores.

card.h3: Exact matching and structured queries matter
ul: Queries contain unique identifiers, SKUs, or exact phrases where precision is paramount: BM25 and inverted indexes guarantee exact matches.
Semantic search fails on rare terms or out-of-domain vocabulary: embeddings may not distinguish subtle differences, returning false positives.
But keyword search fails on synonymy, misspellings, and natural language: it cannot understand that 'car' and 'automobile' are the same.
Hybrid search combines both: keyword handles exact matches, semantic handles intent, and fusion ensures no trade-off in recall or precision.
